audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 46.08% over 1085 games — Mel wins most lane stages on paper but Akshan's roam/revive and 6 window explain the losing WR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Akshan,Akshan,Akshan,Akshan,Skill,Skill,Skill while packet and content both say Mel,Mel,Mel,Mel,Akshan,Mel,Mel — and the full whys for rows 0-3 describe Mel winning under an Akshan side, the exact side/why contradiction QA reverted 189 of.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-grounded (passive/W shield need minion hits, no Heroic Swing before 3, Solar Snare cancels the swing, Comeuppance is the 6 spike). Full layer moved to agree.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Mel,Mel,Mel,Mel,Akshan,Mel,Mel with whys rewritten per row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every Akshan spell (Q, E shots, R, even passive extra attack) is projectile-flagged, so the generic 'know which of his spells aren't projectiles' line is wrong here; Going Rogue camouflage never mentioned despite the stealth-needs-vision missing interaction; no cooldown digits.
audit.why: Kit: Q 9-5s, E 18-12s, R 100/85/70 projectile, W camouflage. Mel W reflects all of it; Solar Snare cancels the swing dash.
audit.corrected: Folded into edits: cooldown numbers, camouflage/sweeper line in breakdown.mid, projectile facts in dos/donts.

edits.after: Akshan wins by swinging in off cooldown trades, shielding your chip with his passive, and cashing Comeuppance at 6.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Rebuttal spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: 18s rank 1, 12s max — his only engage/escape; fight while it is down. - Comeuppance: 100/85/70s and a projectile — Rebuttal returns the stored shots. - Your W (38s rank 1) is for his all-in, not his poke.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Every Akshan spell is a projectile — walking at him with the glow up turns his Q, swing shots and even R into your damage.

edits.before: Your W only answers projectiles — know which of his spells aren't, or the glow is just a light show.
edits.after: Post-6 his R locks on from 2500 and Heroic Swing crosses the lane — past midline you are in execute range.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Here the reflect answers everything — Q, swing shots, Comeuppance — but only while it lasts; his passive shield still soaks your return.

notes: Packet defect says the chart (Mel 6/7 stages) contradicts the 46.08% WR; the kit supports Mel winning the lane stages (Akshan's shield/passive are minion-fed, Solar Snare cancels his swing), so the losing WR likely comes from his W roam/revive map game rather than lane stages — chart left as packet+content agree, full layer aligned to them. tldr keeps 'His dive isn't a projectile', which is defensible (the swing dash itself is not a projectile; its shots are) but slightly muddy — flagged, not edited, to preserve the report[0].t duplicate without spending report-cap edits. report[8].t 'anti-heal early into his sustain' is dubious (Akshan has no heal; passive is a shield) — outside the report lint flags so left, recorded here. sectionsMissing (templated, not grounded): breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, breakdown.difficulty, breakdown.spikes, tradeGood/tradeBad (shared template but factually sound here since all his spells are projectiles).
